row_semantics: Each row defines a specific configuration parameter for the passenger seat, including its description, valid range, definition/conversion values, and default setting.

column_semantics.配置项/Item: The name of the configuration parameter being defined.
column_semantics.配置描述/Description: A brief description of what the configuration parameter controls or represents.
column_semantics.参数范围/Range: The valid numerical range for the parameter value.
column_semantics.定义/Conversion: The mapping between the parameter value (in hexadecimal) and its corresponding seat configuration (e.g., Five-seat or Six-seat).
column_semantics.默认值/Default: The default value assigned to the parameter if no other value is specified.

core_entities.name: Configure Passenger
core_entities.description: Defines the seating configuration for the passenger area, specifically whether it is set to five seats or six seats.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the configuration parameter for the passenger seat layout, which can be used to verify that the system correctly interprets and applies the five-seat or six-seat configuration based on the input parameter value.
